passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Alcohol is reimbursed only as part of pre-approved client entertainment.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Professional engineering licence renewals are reimbursed. Claim the renewal fee with the receipt. Fees for licences in additional jurisdictions are reimbursed when your manager agrees they are needed for your projects.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Submit claims within 30 days of the expense. Claims older than 60 days are not reimbursed without a director exception. Submitting promptly helps projects bill clients accurately and helps Finance close each month. For a long trip, you may submit claims as you go rather than waiting until you return.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Client entertainment, such as a meal with a client, is reimbursed up to $100 per person and needs your manager's pre-approval. On your claim, list the people attended, their organisations and the business purpose. Entertainment for public officials needs extra care; check with your manager first. Gifts and hospitality you receive from others are covered by RSE-HB-01 §4.3.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: These are not reimbursed: personal travel costs, traffic or parking fines, upgrades without approval, family travel, and personal entertainment. Personal entertainment includes in-flight films, hotel films, gym fees and sightseeing. Family travel includes the costs of a partner or family members travelling with you, even when they share your room or car.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: When you combine business and personal travel, airfare is reimbursed up to the business-only comparison fare, which Ridgeline Travel quotes at booking for the dates the business trip alone would need.

passages.title: Work Location, Travel & Cross-Border Work Guidelines
passages.text: Book flights, hotels and rental cars through Ridgeline Travel, the internal booking portal. Travel costs are reimbursed under the Travel & Expense Reimbursement policy (RSE-EXP-01).

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Your manager pre-approves every business trip before you book it (RSE-LOC-01 §2.1).

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Attach an itemised receipt for every item of $25 or more. A card statement is not a receipt. Photograph paper receipts and attach them to your claim in the HR Portal. If a receipt is lost, explain on the claim; your manager decides whether to approve it.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Lodging and meals on personal days are not reimbursed. For example, if you attend meetings at another office for three days and stay on for a few days of vacation, Ridgeline reimburses lodging and meals for the business days within the limits in §4 and §5.1, and airfare up to the business-only comparison fare. Lodging and meals for the vacation days are yours, and the vacation days are PTO.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Feature | Dental
Preventive care | Cleanings and check-ups covered in network
Basic and major care | Fillings, crowns and other treatment shared with the plan
You can join the dental plan even if you waive medical coverage, and you can choose a different coverage level for dental than for medical. Details of the dental network are in the plan documents.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
For medical, dental and vision you choose one coverage level: employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or family.
You can choose a different coverage level for each plan, for example family medical coverage and employee-only vision. Your coverage level stays the same for the plan year unless you have a qualifying life event (§3.4).

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Benefits eligibility depends on your Employment Type. Full-time employees are eligible for all US plans in §2. Part-time employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision and the 401(k); Ridgeline's employer contribution to medical premiums is pro-rated by scheduled hours. Interns are eligible for the 401(k) only. Contractors are not eligible for Ridgeline benefits. Employees of the Toronto office are covered by the RSE Canada Group Plan instead of the US plans (§5).
Your eligibility is based on the Employment Type on your HR record. If your Employment Type changes, for example from part-time to full-time, your eligibility changes from the date of the change, and you can update your elections within the qualifying life event window (§3.4).

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Feature | Medical HDHP with HSA
Premiums | Lower premiums, higher deductible
Health savings account (HSA) | Ridgeline contributes $750 a year for employee-only coverage, or $1,500 a year for any coverage that includes family members
Who it suits | Employees who want lower premiums and to save for health costs tax-efficiently
Ridgeline's HSA contribution is paid into your account in instalments through the year, and the account is yours to keep if you leave. You can add your own contributions through payroll. The HDHP pays for preventive care before the deductible is met.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Employees of the Toronto office are covered by the RSE Canada Group Plan, which provides health, dental and other group benefits for Canadian employees. This summary does not describe the plan in detail. Plan details, claims and eligibility questions for the RSE Canada Group Plan go to HR.
The US plan descriptions in §2 do not apply to Toronto employees, even where the plans have similar names. Toronto employees enrol in the RSE Canada Group Plan through HR when they join, and HR provides the plan booklet and claim forms.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Feature | 401(k) retirement plan
Employer match | 100% of the first 4% of pay you contribute
Vesting | Immediate: the match is yours from day one
You choose how much of your pay to contribute and can change it at any time in the HR Portal. To receive the full match, contribute at least 4% of your pay. Interns may join the 401(k) but are not eligible for the other US plans.

passages.title: Leave of Absence Policy
passages.text:
Medical leave beyond sick time is arranged with HR directly. You share medical information only with HR. Your manager is told only the dates you will be away and any adjustments to your work.
Contact HR as soon as you know you will need medical leave, or ask someone to contact HR for you. HR will explain the options, the documents needed and how your pay and benefits are handled while you are away. Requests are handled through HR Confidential where you prefer.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Feature | Medical PPO
Network | In-network and out-of-network providers; lower cost in network
Primary care referral | Not needed to see a specialist
Who it suits | Employees who want the widest choice of providers
Plan-specific costs, deductibles and provider lists are in the plan documents in the HR Portal.
The PPO suits people who want to keep seeing particular doctors, who travel often within the US, or who expect regular care during the year. Your share of the premium is taken from your pay before tax each pay period. You can compare the PPO and the HDHP side by side in the HR Portal before you enrol.

passages.title: Approval Matrix
passages.text:
Request | Approver
Home-office stipend | Manager
Benefits changes | None (self-service in the window); HR for exceptions

passages.title: Leave of Absence Policy
passages.text:
If you need a workplace accommodation for a disability, a health condition or pregnancy, contact HR directly through HR Confidential or the HR Service Desk. HR will talk with you about what you need, keep your information confidential, and tell your manager only about the work adjustments, not the reason for them.
Accommodations might include changes to your schedule, equipment, workspace or duties. You can ask at any time, including before you join. HR may ask for information from a medical professional where it is needed to understand what will help, and will explain why.
